s1.syndrome_frame: Acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain with fever and elevated inflammatory markers
salient_findings: Abdominal CT scan showing a swollen and thickened tubular structure with a pericecal collection
key_facts: 24-hour history of right iliac fossa pain
History of laparoscopic appendectomy 8 months earlier
Pain in the right lower quadrant without peritoneal signs
Abdominal CT scan showing a swollen and thickened tubular structure
Pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain with fever and elevated inflammatory markers
salient_findings: Abdominal CT scan showing a swollen and thickened tubular structure with a pericecal collection
key_facts: 24-hour history of right iliac fossa pain
History of laparoscopic appendectomy 8 months earlier
Pain in the right lower quadrant without peritoneal signs

Pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips

differentials: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor of the cecum
per_call: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor of the cecum

shortlist.label: Appendiceal stump appendicitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of laparoscopic appendectomy and current right lower quadrant pain

shortlist.label: Pericecal abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Abdominal CT scan showing pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips

shortlist.label: Cecal diverticulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Abdominal CT scan showing swollen and thickened tubular structure at the cecal pole

shortlist.label: Typhlitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated white-blood-cell count and C-reactive protein level, consistent with neutropenic colitis or typhlitis

shortlist.label: Perforated appendicitis
shortlist.why_kept: Fever, elevated inflammatory markers, and abdominal CT scan findings consistent with perforation

raw.rationale: The patient's history of laparoscopic appendectomy 8 months earlier and the presence of a swollen and thickened tubular structure at the cecal pole with a pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips on the abdominal CT scan support this diagnosis, as appendiceal stump appendicitis is a known complication of appendectomy.

rejected.label: Pericecal abscess
rejected.why: While the patient has a pericecal collection, the presence of a swollen and thickened tubular structure suggests a more specific diagnosis related to the appendiceal stump.

rejected.label: Cecal diverticulitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of a diverticulum on the CT scan, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Typhlitis
rejected.why: Typhlitis typically occurs in immunocompromised patients, which is not indicated in the vignette.

rejected.label: Perforated appendicitis
rejected.why: The patient had an appendectomy 8 months earlier, making perforated appendicitis unlikely.
